headline: Michael Lorenzen no-hits the Nationals
recap: Michael Lorenzen threw a complete-game no-hitter at Citizens Bank Park, walking four and striking out five over nine innings as the Phillies beat the Washington Nationals 7-0. The Nationals reached base only on four walks; the no-hitter ended when Dominic Smith flied out to center fielder Johan Rojas.

Nationals starter MacKenzie Gore was tagged for six runs on seven hits over five innings and took the loss. Nick Castellanos led the Phillies at the plate with two home runs and three RBI, driving in Bryce Harper with a first-inning shot and going deep again in the third.
Weston Wilson also homered, in the second inning, and RBI singles from Johan Rojas in the fourth and Alec Bohm in the seventh rounded out the Phillies' scoring.
